take_homes: Default to one agent. Split only when the agents need different access, speak different dialects or must disagree. If one prompt gives the same quality, use the one prompt.
Handoffs between agents are where the errors enter, and nothing in this setup checks whether the final briefing is true. The doubt stays.
A synthesizer given a framework has to choose a diagnosis. Without one it averages the views into mush.

misconception.why: This did not sound like the last programmes. It told me not to use its own headline idea unless needed, it admitted the synthesis cannot be verified, and I could test claims myself. I still don't know how it holds up at our scale, so I am not convinced yet, but 'wait and see' is no longer an obviously safe default.

one_line: Surprisingly honest: it tells you to use one agent unless you have a reason, and that none of this checks whether the answer is true. I still want to see it on a real problem.
